name: p0_us_ai_power_gw
note: US AI-dedicated data-center power at end-2025. Epoch: global AI ~30 GW in Q4 2025; US taken as roughly half. Epoch's tracked frontier sites total 13.5 GW IT power (https://epoch.ai/data/data-centers).

name: demand_growth
note: What the industry wants to build. Epoch: US AI power 'could reach 100 GW' by 2030 if the trend continues, i.e. ~1.46x/yr from 15 GW. Goldman: US data-center load 31 -> 41 -> 66 GW over 2025-27.

name: hw_eff_growth
note: Epoch: energy efficiency (FLOP/W) of leading GPUs/TPUs doubles about every 2 years (~40%/yr).

name: alg_eff_growth
note: Epoch: compute needed for a fixed level of language-model performance halves roughly every 8 months (95% CI 5-14 months). 2.0 is the conservative case.

name: space_kw_per_tonne
note: Compute power per tonne launched, all-in (arrays, radiators, compute, structure). SpaceX AI1 implies ~70 kW/t; Musk's Feb 2026 memo assumes 100 kW/t.

name: space_tonnes_per_launch
note: SpaceX prospectus: 'Starship V3 is designed to deliver 100 metric tons to Earth's orbit in a fully reusable configuration.' Design goal, not demonstrated.

name: space_sat_life_years
note: Google Suncatcher paper: reference satellite life 5 years; repair 'impracticable in space'.

name: dc_utilization
note: Assumption: average draw as a fraction of nameplate facility power, for the share-of-generation calculation only.

name: us_electricity_twh_2026
note: EIA STEO: US electricity sales 4,135 billion kWh in 2026.

name: us_electricity_growth
note: Assumption: US electricity sales grow 1.5%/yr (EIA STEO shows 4,135 -> 4,211 TWh from 2026 to 2027, +1.8%).

name: campus_trend_base_gw
note: Anchor for the single-site trend: the record AI campus (xAI Colossus 2) at ~950 MW of IT power in June 2026 (Epoch).

name: campus_trend_doubling_months
note: Epoch: since mid-2024 the record for the largest AI data center by IT power has doubled every ten months (2.3x per year).
